mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals economic weakness that triggers monetary policy easing, which subsequently boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL 12-month growth below 2%) indicates a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong housing starts (HOUST above 900), the market anticipates monetary tightening and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (above 95) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly payroll gain (above 150,000 jobs) signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase (as indicated by quarterly GDP growth above 2% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to rally due to improving economic fundamentals, producing positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 4q growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS above 400 million dollars) and robust housing starts (HOUST above 900) signals broad-based economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400 and HOUST exceeds 900.
